revisions.purpose: Release0.3.25: every material on the Tc chart now carries its name and the names twinkle instead of being permanently placed, so all 48 can be read without crowding: four or five fade in and out at a time (two on a phone), staggered starts and uneven lifetimes keep them out of step, the rotation moves on one name at a time with a cooldown so each has its turn before any repeats, among the next few candidates the one furthest from the names already up is chosen, a name appears only once its year has arrived and the chosen material's name is pinned while its panel is open; with reduced motion the chart keeps the previous fixed set of names and no fading; the chart's frame loop now also drives the names, so it runs while the view is open, restarts when the view is returned to and when the year slider is moved, and still stops when the view is left; the year axis is marked every decade with a half-decade tick between, and every twenty years on a narrow screen; the data, the models and the results are unchanged

news thumbnail badges come only from the article's own text after the negation and history checks; colour and framing variants carry no meaning

the new structure animations are labelled schematics with alt text naming what is not shown: no measured coordinates, measured vibration or pairing mechanism is claimed
the year sweep honours reduced motion, pauses while the page is hidden and cancels its frame loop when the view is left or the chart is rebuilt

a name is never shown for a material the year sweep has not reached yet
